caption: The drawing features a large, rust-colored, three-pronged fishing or grappling hook set against a light beige background. Each prong of the hook curves outward and ends in a sharp, pointed tip. The metal surface of the hook appears textured and aged, with visible variations in the brownish-red color suggesting rust or patina. At the top, the three shafts of the hook converge and form an elongated loop. Beneath the hook, there is text reading "FRANK VOLEM 1939" written in small, capitalized letters. The composition is centered, and the hook is vertically oriented, occupying the majority of the visual space. There are no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Grappling Hook
